hypothesis: Can the accepted local candidate search retain the real final answer for ten historical user questions: five from Claude Code and five from Codex?

sample.turn_definition: a user message followed by one or more assistant messages before the next user message
sample.gold: the final visible assistant message before the next user message
sample.query_handling: remove all ten exact user messages from the searchable candidates

claim_boundary: This tests ten exact historical questions from two conversations. It does not validate paraphrased new questions, empty answers, semantic sufficiency, ChatGPT extraction or production-scale retrieval.
